# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# polaris-collab — 多人协作引擎 crate(分仓规划 v2 第 5 仓的仓内形态)
# 账号/授权表/任务卡/合并闸门/检查工作流/Gitea/iroh 隧道/云中继网关。
# 边界铁律: 只准向下依赖 polaris-kernel(skills 检查技能)与 polaris-runtime(host shim);
#   应用数据面 apihub 与桌面内嵌主机 hosting 是壳件, 留在 polaris-app —— 本 crate
#   不认识 kb/chat/fable 等任何同层引擎, 编译器物理保证。
# 特性: collab-host(axum 协作路由) / collab-net(iroh 隧道+云中继) / desktop(tauri 命令)。
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[package]
name = "polaris-collab"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
polaris-kernel = { path = "../polaris-kernel" }
polaris-runtime = { path = "../polaris-runtime" }
# 版本与主 crate 逐条对齐(同 workspace 共享编译产物,零增量)
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
anyhow = "1"
once_cell = "1"
parking_lot = "0.12"
regex = "1"
directories = "5"
walkdir = "2"
ureq = { version = "2", features = ["json"] }
base64 = "0.22"
hex = "0.4"
sha2 = "0.10"
getrandom = "0.2"
chrono = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["clock"] }
rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled"] }
# 账号密码哈希(argon2id PHC)与账号镜像加密(云端零知识)
argon2 = "0.5"
chacha20poly1305 = "0.10"
# 账号权威签名(Ed25519):云机签身份断言,成员主机离线验签 —— 不进 collab-net,
# 因为**普通桌面主机也要验签**,而它不编 iroh。
ed25519-dalek = { version = "2", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["time", "macros", "rt-multi-thread", "sync", "net", "io-util", "signal"] }
tauri = { version = "2.1", features = [], optional = true }
# 协作路由(collab-host)
axum = { version = "0.7", features = ["ws", "multipart"], optional = true }
# 邮箱验证码(注册/找回密码)发信:阻塞 SMTP + rustls(避开 OpenSSL,QQ 邮箱 465 隐式 TLS)
lettre = { version = "0.11", default-features = false, features = ["smtp-transport", "builder", "hostname", "rustls-tls"], optional = true }
# 远程盘读文件的传输压缩(Accept-Encoding: zstd 时才启用)。这棵依赖本来就在树里
# (zip → polaris-kernel),这里只是显式点名,不新增编译负担。
zstd = { version = "0.13", optional = true }
tower = { version = "0.5", optional = true }
tower-http = { version = "0.6", features = ["fs", "cors", "trace"], optional = true }
futures-util = { version = "0.3", optional = true }
# 组网隧道 + 云中继(collab-net):iroh 依赖树大,默认不进
iroh = { version = "1", optional = true }
# mDNS 局域网发现:纯内网(无外网,n0 DNS/relay 全不可达)时,同网段设备也能互相发现直连
iroh-mdns-address-lookup = { version = "0.4", optional = true }
tokio-tungstenite = { version = "0.24", optional = true }

[features]
default = []
desktop = ["dep:tauri"]
collab-host = ["dep:axum", "dep:tower", "dep:tower-http", "dep:futures-util", "dep:lettre", "dep:zstd"]
collab-net = ["dep:iroh", "dep:iroh-mdns-address-lookup", "dep:tokio-tungstenite"]
{
  "name": "polaris-app",
  "private": true,
  "version": "2.9.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build",
    "check:boundaries": "node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs",
